keyFindings: The guest is Windows 10 Home 22H2 build 10.0.19045.2965. Its uxtheme.dll is 10.0.19041.2193, the same build as the decomp reference. comctl32 v6 is file version 6.10.19041.1110 and DllGetVersion reports 6.16.10586; v5 is 5.82.19041.1110 (DllGetVersion 5.82.10586).

The session is themed as soon as run.cmd starts (uptime about 33 s), so no wait or 'sc start themes' is needed. The Themes service is RUNNING, explorer and dwm are up, the process is in session 1 on WinSta0\Default, and it runs as the built-in Administrator, elevated (TokenElevation=1, type 1).

Theme state at that point: IsThemeActive=1, IsAppThemed=1, IsCompositionActive=1, GetThemeAppProperties=0x3. GetCurrentThemeName returns S_OK with Aero.msstyles / NormalColor / NormalSize, while the theme file is light.theme.
Display defaults: 1024x768x32 at 96 dpi, high contrast off (flags 0x7E), light mode, and uxtheme ordinals #132 and #138 both return 0.

CC30 is confirmed: a SysHeader32 in a comctl32 v6 process measures 24 px with HDM_LAYOUT (DEFAULT_GUI_FONT and Segoe UI 9). Without a manifest (v5) it is 17 px, or 19 with Segoe UI, and unthemed. A v5 process that activates a v6 activation context gets 24 px.

Header theme data: GetThemePartSize(HEADER, HP_HEADERITEM, state 1 or 0, TS_TRUE) = 6x24 with both a NULL and a screen DC. GetThemePosition(HP_HEADERITEM, TMT_MINSIZE) returns 0x80070490, so the 24 comes from the TS_TRUE part size, not from TMT_MINSIZE.
Bug fixed: the XML comment in tools/probe_app.manifest contained '--', which made the manifest invalid. Every exe embedding it, including probe_record.exe, failed on real Windows with error 14001.
Unmanifested Makefile exes get comctl32 5.82. An area can now opt into v6 as the process default with tests/<area>/app.rc containing '1 24 "app_v6.manifest"'.

Dark mode switches at runtime: setting AppsUseLightTheme and SystemUsesLightTheme to 0 and broadcasting ImmersiveColorSet makes #132 and #138 return 1 in the next process. The msstyles values do not change.

High contrast switches at runtime with SPI_SETHIGHCONTRAST: the theme becomes AeroLite.msstyles, HP_HEADERITEM TS_TRUE becomes 3x3 and the header is 17 px. The switch is asynchronous (a process started 0.2 s later still saw Aero values), so theme_config waits 10 s after it.

Win10 has no system-wide classic mode: 'sc stop Themes' and start=disabled plus a reboot both leave IsThemeActive=1 with Aero and a 24 px header. Unthemed behaviour is only reachable per process or per window.

DPI configurations need a logoff, not a reboot, but autologon only signs back in after a logoff when ForceAutoLogon=1, which vm_run.sh now sets. Without it the guest sat at the logon screen until the timeout.

DPI configs work at 120, 144 and 192 even on the 1024x768 display. probe_record (system-aware) header heights: 26 at 120 dpi, 31 at 144 and 40 at 192, themed and unthemed alike. DPI-unaware processes see 120 at 125% but are virtualized to 96 at 150% and 200%.

Once in about 14 boots the guest hung: it reached the desktop but nothing reached COM1. vm_run.sh now stops such a guest through QMP quit after 240 s of silence and retries the boot once. This watchdog has not been exercised on a real hang yet.

The whole chain was proven: core_smoke 3/3 OK, plus probe_record --prio 0 (509 rows) under aero and dark, through vm_matrix.sh. Two aero runs in different boots differed in only one key, GetSystemMetrics(93) (596 vs 600).

The foundation work is committed on master in three commits (e9a674e, 2d9c9b5, 7b2425b), not pushed.

Files added or changed:
- /home/iceisfun/industrial7_test_theme/tools/vm_run.sh is the runner. It takes EXE[,EXE...] or --all; options include --filter, --timeout, --config NAME[@MODE], --probe "ARGS", --env-only, --per-boot, --destructive, --keep. Exit code is 0 (all OK), 1 (test failures) or 3 (infrastructure problem).
- /home/iceisfun/industrial7_test_theme/tools/vm_split.py splits the serial log into per-exe files. It flags MISSING, TRUNCATED, TIMEOUT, SPAWNFAIL, NOSUMMARY and BADSUMMARY (the SUMMARY line is cross-checked against the RUN/OK/FAIL/SKIP lines); this was tested on a synthetic log.
- /home/iceisfun/industrial7_test_theme/tools/vm_matrix.sh runs the same exes under several configurations and writes results/win10-matrix.txt.

- Guest helpers are in /home/iceisfun/industrial7_test_theme/tools/vm/: vmrun.c (job object, timeout, COM1 framing), themeenv.c (environment report and theme gate), themeset.c (high contrast and setting-change broadcast) and app_v6.manifest. They build with make -f tools/Makefile.vm.

- Docs: /home/iceisfun/industrial7_test_theme/docs/VM_RUN.md and /home/iceisfun/industrial7_test_theme/docs/VM_THEME_ENV.md. Raw evidence is in /home/iceisfun/industrial7_test_theme/docs/vm_evidence/ (environment reports for every configuration plus probe CSVs), because results/ is gitignored.

Things for the integrator:
- Run directories stay under ~/w10lab/runs/theme-* when --keep is used. Several from this session are still there (their disks were deleted).
- The run directory path must stay short because QEMU's QMP socket path is limited to 108 bytes. An output directory under the scratchpad failed for that reason.
- Do not edit vm_run.sh while it is running: bash reads the script as it goes, and that produced a syntax error once during my testing.
- There is no Win10 configuration in which the theme is inactive. Expectations for 'theme inactive' tests must come from the decomp or from per-process unthemed states such as SetThemeAppProperties(0), v5 controls or SetWindowTheme(h, L"", L"").
- tools/probe_compare.py works on the CSVs vm_run.sh produces, because the frame lines are stripped from data files.
- A qemu guest seen early in the session with its disk in scratchpad/out was not mine, and I left it alone. The one guest I stopped with QMP quit was my own hung boot.

keyFindings: Header floor does not scale with DPI: GetThemePartSize(HP_HEADERITEM, TS_TRUE) is 6x24 at every DPI (explicit 96/120/144/192 and every system DPI, aware or unaware). HDM_LAYOUT cy floors at 24. Above the floor it is text based: cy = tmHeight + 4 at 96, +6 at 120 and 144, +8 at 192. Examples: tm20 -> 26 at 120 and 144, 28 at 192; tm25 -> 31 at 144, 33 at 192. This confirms the 24 px derivation (TS_TRUE image height, TMT_MINSIZE E_PROP_ID_UNSUPPORTED) and adds that it is not 24*scale.

OpenThemeDataForDpi(N) results depend on the system DPI, not only on N. 750 of 12668 dpi-table rows differ between a system-120 and a system-144 run at the same explicit DPI. Example: HP_HEADERSORTARROW TS_TRUE at explicit 120 is 16x6 under system 120 but 13x5 under system 144. Constants for those parts must be keyed by (object DPI, system DPI). The explicit-DPI values from aero_light_96 do not carry over to scaled machines.

A DPI-unaware process at 120 sees the same values as a system-aware one (LOGPIXELS 120, no virtualization). At 144 and 192 an unaware process is virtualized to 96, with a 683x512 or 512x384 screen. About 7.6k rows still differ from the 96-DPI recording (mostly screen-size metrics; not categorised).
pmv2 is identical to system-aware in every row of the std pass; only the DpiAwareness row differs (single-monitor VM).

Repeatability: the 6 probe passes at each of the 3 DPIs are identical line for line across two fresh boots (0 differing lines after dropping time_utc and SM93). probe_draw and filehash differ only in elapsed-ms timing. No CRASH, HANG, OPENFAIL, NOAPI or NODIB row anywhere.
Theme state in the VM: themed immediately at every DPI, Aero NormalColor, comctl32 6.10.19041.1110, uxtheme 10.0.19041.2193. The logoff stage works with ForceAutoLogon.
